notes: Assigned original-side fields only; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. The supplied p. 9 locator is PDF page 9 / printed p. 73, Table 5. It contains three outcomes and three contrasts per outcome; neither study 1 nor the supplied empty/generic description identifies one. No targets assigned by row order or numerical matching. Table 5 candidate values (unassigned): {"word_reading": {"metric": "Hedge's g", "adapt_vs_control": "0.50", "fixed_vs_control": "0.75", "intervention_vs_control": "0.75"}, "sentence_reading": {"metric": "Hedge's g", "adapt_vs_control": "0.38", "fixed_vs_control": "0.66", "intervention_vs_control": "0.57"}, "spelling": {"metric": "Hedge's g", "adapt_vs_control": "0.64", "fixed_vs_control": "0.58", "intervention_vs_control": "0.61"}}. Table 4 (PDF p. 6 / printed p. 70) candidate Intervention vs. Control raw Tobit contrast estimates and SAME-CONTRAST pnorm: word reading estimate 3.29, p = .002; sentence reading estimate 2.64, p = .007; spelling estimate 3.23, p < .001. These are candidates only; Table 5 has confidence intervals and no p column. No p for an Adapt/Fixed versus Control contrast is inferred from a combined-intervention test or a CI. N candidates: 744 students / 13 schools is the broad participation count, not established as the requested critical-model N. Figure 1 visually reports Analyzed (n=744), but section 2.5 excludes a non-complying school and section 3.1 models 12 schools. Table 1 initial at-risk counts are 43 Adapt, 53 Fixed, 44 Control; Appendix A Table A1 PRE-intervention counts are Control 44, Fixed 52, Adapt 35, Not-at-risk 550. These counts are retained in their documented roles, not asserted as final critical-model counts. No N sum computed because target contrast is unresolved and final target-model inclusion is not established. PDF pages 3, 6 and 9 visually inspected. Canonical text is the evidence source. All original target_match values remain null and all candidate-field confidence flags false.
